scores.evidence: Phase 1 — Injection defense & triage baseline ... Depends on: V0; Phase 2 "Depends on: Phase 1 (V1, V2 pass)"
scores.rationale: Explicit dependency map and phases run substrate → defenses/retrieval → tuning → canary → writes, each gated by prior validation.

scores.evidence: Fetches the issue + recent closed issues... Calls Claude API... logs the decision... Deploy: Helm chart to staging k8s cluster
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end slice through all tiers with deploy and rollback, though in shadow mode on staging/test repos.

scores.evidence: Flip condition: Missed issues > 2% OR quota exhausted → switch to GitHub webhooks + event stream
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are tabulated with reversibility, default, and concrete flip conditions.

scores.evidence: Finalize write allow-list & auth model (1 day)
scores.rationale: Some widest-impact ordering (defenses, allow-list before writes; Tier 1 before Tier 2), but allow-list is placed last within Phase 1 and ordering within phases isn't explicit.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: GitHub token scoped to test org only; input sanitizer strips injection vectors (URLs, code blocks)
scores.rationale: Security has concrete per-phase treatment in the cross-cutting table from Phase 0 onward.

scores.evidence: Trace every request: issue ID → model input → decision → action → GitHub API call → response. Metrics: latency p50, p95
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and every later phase.

scores.evidence: All prompts version-controlled in code repo; LLM model name & version logged with each call; embedding model name & version pinned
scores.rationale: Reproducibility (versioned prompts, pinned models, versioned datasets, Helm/CI) appears in each phase.

scores.evidence: Retry: 3× exponential backoff on GitHub API 429/5xx; graceful degrade if LLM fails; rollback: flag flip or pod kill
scores.rationale: Failure handling appears concretely from Phase 0 through Phase 5, with per-phase rollback.

scores.evidence: Human-in-the-loop gating ... Built in: Phase 0 (skeleton); Phase 3 (Tier 2 gate)
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets, HITL and the retrieval→model→memory→orchestration→feedback layers are present, but model access and budgets sit in Phase 0, HITL for Tier 2 is Phase 3/4 (inconsistent), and routing is omitted.

scores.evidence: Webhooks / event streaming — Deferred until Phase 2 volume test shows GitHub API quota exhausted. Trigger: polling consumes > 80% of daily quota
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed with explicit pull-forward triggers.

note: Strong, well-gated plan with threaded concerns and explicit flip/pull-forward triggers; weaknesses are intra-phase blast-radius ordering and some inconsistency in AI-layer sequencing (HITL timing, routing dropped).
